An I2C sensor, a chip, and nothing else

Two WebAssembly modules in one tab. The emulator runs real ESP32-C3 firmware that reads an SHT31 with the stock esp_driver_i2c. sht31.wasm, built from examples/parts/sht31, answers at 0x44 on GPIO 6 (SCL) and GPIO 5 (SDA). Change the room and the next reading follows.

Pick the two files this page runs. The firmware is test_apps/i2c_sensor built for esp32c3 (its merged flash image). The part is sht31.wasm, built from examples/parts/sht31.
